Best digital legacy vaults (2026)

For most people, the best digital legacy setup is a password manager with emergency access (Bitwarden or Keeper) plus a planning vault for documents and wishes (Everplans, Prisidio or GoodTrust). The free Google and Apple legacy settings belong on top of either.

Key facts

  • #1 Everplans: Organised planners who want a guided inventory of accounts, wishes and documents.
  • #2 Prisidio: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.
  • #3 GoodTrust: US families who want estate documents and digital-account planning in one place.
  • #4 Bitwarden: Budget-conscious people who want a proper, tested emergency-access workflow.
  • #5 Keeper: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.

Which should you choose?

1. Everplans

Best for: Organised planners who want a guided inventory of accounts, wishes and documents.

A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust.

Pricing: Free base app; Everplans Premium is paid. Check current pricing.

2. Prisidio

Best for: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.

A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.

Pricing: Check current pricing.

3. GoodTrust

Best for: US families who want estate documents and digital-account planning in one place.

An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

Pricing: Estate+ plan advertised at $149 (US). Check current pricing.

4. Bitwarden

Best for: Budget-conscious people who want a proper, tested emergency-access workflow.

The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

Pricing: Free plan available; Emergency Access requires Premium or a paid Families/Teams/Enterprise plan. Check current pricing.

5. Keeper

Best for: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.

A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.

Pricing: Paid plans with a free trial. Check current pricing.
